items.title: 25.2 Kuch compounds ki retrosynthesis aur synthesis (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 25.2 with Quick Check 25.2 answered (PDF 137-139). Answers need review.

blocks.text: Nishan lagi jagah (ester ka C–O bond) par disconnection karne se synthon A aur synthon B milte hain; in ke synthetic equivalents bhi dikhaye gaye hain. Synthetic equivalents chunte waqt yeh dekhna zaroori hai ke yeh aapas mein react kar ke target molecule de sakein.
In synthons ko neutral (charge khatam) kar ke synthetic equivalents milte hain: acetic acid (synthon A, CH₃CO⁺ ke liye) aur ethanol (synthon B, C₂H₅O⁻ ke liye).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Step II mein yahan “benzene and nitric acid” likha hai; yeh alfaaz aniline wali misal ke hain. Ethyl acetate ke synthetic equivalents acetic acid aur ethanol hain, jaisa scheme aur agla jumla batate hain.
Is tarah target molecule ethyl acetate ka disconnection aur phir neutralization humein acetic acid aur ethanol deta hai, jo TM banane ke liye saada starting materials hain.

blocks.alt: Step I: ethyl acetate, C=O wale carbon aur ester oxygen ke bond par lehredaar katt, 'Disconnection' teer, phir acylium ion H3C-C(=O)+ synthon (A) aur ethoxide ion -O-C2H5 synthon (B). Step II: synthon (A) acetic acid (SE) aur synthon (B) ethanol (SE) ke barabar. Synthesis: CH3-COOH + C2H5-OH, H2SO4 ke saath, se CH3-CO-O-C2H5 + H2O.
blocks.caption: Misal 25.2.1: ethyl acetate ka retrosynthetic tree aur synthesis (kitab ke PDF safha 137-138 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Retrosynthesis ko oopar se neeche parhein: Step I mein ester ka C–O bond kaata gaya (lehredaar nishan), jis se acylium ion (A) aur ethoxide ion (B) bane. Step II mein ≡ ka nishan batata hai ke in ki jagah lab mein kaun se asal reagents (SE) istemal honge: acetic acid aur ethanol.
Ab TM ki synthesis jaani pehchani esterification reaction (acid + alcohol se ester banana) se hoti hai: acetic acid aur ethanol H₂SO₄ ki maujoodgi mein react kar ke ethyl acetate aur paani dete hain.

Yahan retrosynthesis ka pehla step FGI hai: amino group (NH₂) ko nitro (NO₂) group mein badla jata hai. Wajah yeh hai ke nitro group benzene par electrophilic substitution se aasani se lag jata hai, jab ke amino group nucleophilic substitution se nahi lagaya ja sakta.
Doosre step mein nitrobenzene ka C–N bond toora gaya. Is se do synthons bane: aryl anion (C₆H₅⁻) aur nitronium (NO₂⁺) cation.

In synthons ko neutral kar ke synthetic equivalents milte hain: benzene aur nitric acid. Synthesis mein benzene ki HNO₃/H₂SO₄ se nitration hoti hai aur phir nitrobenzene Sn + HCl se reduce ho kar aniline ban jata hai.

blocks.alt: Step I: aniline (NH2 wala benzene) aur khula teer 'FGI' nitrobenzene tak. Step II: nitrobenzene ke C-N bond par lehredaar katt, 'Disconnection' teer, phir manfi charge wala benzene ring synthon (A) aur musbat charge wala NO2 synthon (B). Step III: benzene (H dikhaya gaya), teer ke oopar HNO3 aur neeche H2SO4, se nitrobenzene, phir Sn + HCl se aniline.
blocks.caption: Misal 25.2.2: aniline ka retrosynthetic tree (kitab ke PDF safha 138 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Pehle step mein acetophenone (TM) ka ring aur C=O group ke darmiyan C–C bond toora gaya. Is se aryl anion (C₆H₅⁻) aur acylium (CH₃CO⁺) cation synthons bane.
In synthons ko neutral kar ke synthetic equivalents milte hain: benzene aur acyl chloride.

blocks.alt: Step I: acetophenone (C(=O)CH3 wala benzene), ring aur carbon ke bond par lehredaar katt, 'Disconnection' teer, phir manfi charge wala benzene ring synthon (A) aur acylium ion H3C-C(=O)+ synthon (B). Step II: synthon (A) benzene (SE) aur synthon (B) acyl chloride H3C-CO-Cl (SE) ke barabar. Synthesis: benzene + acyl chloride, AlCl3 ke saath, se acetophenone + HCl.
blocks.caption: Misal 25.2.3: acetophenone ka retrosynthetic tree aur synthesis (kitab ke PDF safha 138 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Acetophenone benzene aur acyl chloride ke reaction se banta hai, AlCl₃ catalyst ki maujoodgi mein. Is amal ko Friedel-Crafts acylation kehte hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Cholesterol ki tareekhi synthesis pehli baar 1950 ki dahai ke shuru mein do muqabil (competing) groups ne ki: aik ki qayadat Oxford mein Robert Robinson aur doosre ki Harvard mein R. B. Woodward kar rahe the. Cholesterol ki yeh synthetic schemes pehle hi biological studies se andaze mein aa chuki thin.

blocks.prompt: a) Aniline ki synthesis mein benzene ki nitration kyun ki jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Amino group seedha benzene par nahi lagaya ja sakta, lekin nitro group electrophilic substitution se aasani se lag jata hai. Phir nitro group ko Sn + HCl se NH₂ mein reduce kar diya jata hai (FGI).

blocks.prompt: b) Phenyl ethanoate (CH₃COOC₆H₅) dawaiyan banane mein kaam aata hai. Is ka retrosynthetic tree, synthetic equivalents aur linear synthesis batayein.
blocks.explanation: Ester ka C–O bond torein: CH₃COOC₆H₅ ⇒ CH₃CO⁺ + C₆H₅O⁻. Synthetic equivalents: CH₃CO⁺ ke liye ethanoyl chloride (CH₃COCl), aur C₆H₅O⁻ ke liye phenol (C₆H₅OH). Synthesis: CH₃COCl + C₆H₅OH → CH₃COOC₆H₅ + HCl, NaOH jaise base ke saath (phenol ethanoic acid se achhi tarah ester nahi banata).

items: Ethyl acetate: ester ka C–O disconnection ⇒ acetic acid + ethanol; synthesis esterification.
Aniline: FGI (NH₂ ⇒ NO₂) ⇒ benzene + nitric acid; nitration phir Sn + HCl se reduction.
Acetophenone: C–C disconnection ⇒ benzene + acyl chloride; Friedel-Crafts acylation (AlCl₃).
